title: Autonomous Agentic Architecture Guidelines
content: An agentic system relies on a cyclical control loop: Plan, Act (Tool Calling), Observe, and Evaluate. Unlike traditional linear LLM pipelines, an agent maintains mutable state across iterations and dynamically selects tools based on environmental observations.

title: Deterministic Web Audits vs LLM Hallucinations
content: For technical website audits including Core Web Vitals, SSL certificates, and metadata scoring, deterministic parsers (such as Cheerio or BeautifulSoup) reduce latency from 45 seconds to under 2 milliseconds while eliminating LLM hallucination.

title: Cold Outreach Anti-Spam & Deliverability Protocols
content: High deliverability email engines enforce Spintax randomization, plain-text MIME structures, and cryptographic zero-width space injection. These ensure distinct byte signatures for every outgoing message to pass machine learning spam filters.

title: Multi-Model Fallback and Latency Optimization
content: Production AI systems deploy an automated fallback cascade: routing primary high-throughput tasks to Groq LPUs (Llama 3.3 @ 800 tokens/sec), with automatic failover to NVIDIA NIM and Google Gemini upon encountering HTTP 429 rate limits.
